start.welcome_body:
The mayor grants you a patch of fallow land, {coins} 🪙 and a bag of seeds.

Your goal is simple: **grow, harvest, sell, reinvest**.

**Three commands to get going:**
• `/planter` — sow a seed
• `/ferme` — view your farm
• `/recolter` — cash in your work

Stuck? `/aide` answers everything and `/tutoriel` walks you through it.
